lines: d33: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Teresa Zimmerman is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d33: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d33: 🕯️ Teresa is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d33: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d33: 🕯️ Teresa Zimmerman is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d33: What Teresa kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d33: "Teresa's gone." Arjun looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Teresa." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d33: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Fritz blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d33: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d33: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d33: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Teresa Zimmerman, 33 days. The mantle passes to Fritz Cortez.
d33: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Fritz Cortez, 28 — a chimney sweep. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Lucky Rock, Echo Location.
d33: The village's quarrel was with Teresa — and Teresa is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d33: At the grave, Betty, Arjun, Amara and 6 more speak for Fritz — "Teresa trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d33: The fire knew Fritz before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
